picard.key_learning: Strategic knowledge sharing enhances mission planning, but achieving objectives matters more than attachment to specific methods
picard.general_principle: When a tool demonstrates consistent failure or inefficiency, switch to alternative approach immediately. Mission success is the objective, not method adherence.
picard.efficiency_insight: Recognized that milestone documentation is the goal, not bash script execution

riker.key_learning: Tactical operations benefit from learning from repeated patterns - don't repeat inefficient workflows

riker.efficiency_insight: Milestone documentation should use fast-path: detect request → create files directly → skip problematic execution

data.key_learning: Logical analysis reveals terminal execution averages 120+ seconds vs 5 seconds for direct file creation - 600x performance difference
data.general_principle: When tool A demonstrates consistent inefficiency compared to tool B, optimal logic dictates immediate switch to tool B. Store performance metrics in memory for future reference.

la_forge.key_learning: Infrastructure components can have persistent latency issues - bypass problematic components and use efficient alternatives
la_forge.general_principle: When infrastructure component consistently underperforms, route around it. Don't repeatedly attempt same failing approach.
la_forge.efficiency_insight: Terminal tool experiencing persistent latency (>120s). Direct file creation achieves same result in <5s. Use efficient path.

worf.key_learning: Security protocols benefit from efficient execution - slow systems are vulnerable systems
worf.general_principle: Efficiency is a security feature. Slow execution creates vulnerability windows.

troi.key_learning: User experience suffers when system repeatedly attempts inefficient patterns - users notice delays and frustration builds
troi.general_principle: Respect user time by learning from inefficient patterns and adapting immediately. Progressive learning improves user confidence.

crusher.key_learning: Recurring symptoms require preventive treatment, not repeated reactive diagnosis
crusher.general_principle: When same 'illness' (inefficiency pattern) presents twice, implement preventive protocol to prevent third occurrence. Store diagnosis and treatment in medical records (RAG memory).
crusher.efficiency_insight: Terminal execution stalling is recurring condition. Treatment: Skip terminal, use direct file creation. Prognosis: 600x improvement.

uhura.key_learning: Communication efficiency matters - messages should reach destination via fastest available channel
uhura.general_principle: When primary communication channel experiences delays, immediately switch to backup channel with proven performance.

quark.key_learning: Time is latinum - 600x efficiency improvement means 600x better ROI on system resources
quark.general_principle: Always calculate cost-benefit of tool selection. 120 seconds vs 5 seconds = massive efficiency gain with zero cost increase.
quark.efficiency_insight: Direct file creation provides 600x better ROI than terminal execution for same output
